ordering.calendar.events: source calendar-settings row order; date keys remain YYYY-MM-DD
ordering.ordersMap: source order row order; only the first insertion of each date is observable

ordering.announcements: start_date descending, source row number descending for ties

invalidActionFallback.reason: The Worker is not wired into the production React startup and does not emulate GAS action dispatch.

ordering.menu: latest menu_date at or before targetDate for the selected vendor, then source menu row order

intentionalDifferences.difference: GAS authenticates a LINE access token; the diagnostic Worker contract receives a D1 userId.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: None while React remains on GAS; the benchmark uses the same logical user row but excludes authentication time.

intentionalDifferences.difference: The current D1 POC has one display_name source, while GAS can distinguish the registered Users name from the current LINE profile displayName.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: None for a representative dataset where the values agree; a mismatch must block live parity rather than be silently normalized.

intentionalDifferences.difference: GAS web-app errors are JSON envelopes normally returned through HTTP 200; Worker uses explicit 4xx/5xx statuses.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: None because the Worker is not production-routed. Error body codes remain stable for diagnostics.

intentionalDifferences.difference: GAS backend timing contains LINE and Apps Script stages; Worker timing contains D1/query stages and cannot reproduce LINE_PROFILE_MS.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: None; timing fields are diagnostic and excluded from semantic parity comparison.

intentionalDifferences.difference: Worker does not emulate GAS action dispatch or the legacy fallback waterfall.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: None while production remains on the existing GAS route.

intentionalDifferences.difference: Menu, deadline, setting, and active likes/announcements are deliberately absent from primary bootstrap and live in deferred/order-page contracts.
intentionalDifferences.frontendImpact: Matches current React startup consumption and prevents deferred or order-page data from inflating the primary benchmark payload.

intentionalDifferences.difference: Worker /api/users/:id and /api/orders?userId= remain POC diagnostics and are not primary bootstrap parity inputs.
